systems.system: Death certification and cause-of-death notification process
systems.owner: health sector (National Directorate of Health), with WHO support and Portuguese Cooperation funding
systems.tiers: all levels of care; trainers from various islands trained to cascade across districts; assessed nationally 14-16 April 2025, which recommended digitising notifications in real time

systems.system: IT equipment for the certification and notification process
systems.tiers: to be reinforced under the joint initiative to modernise death registration

note: WHO's account of the April 2025 assessment of death certification: nearly 100 per cent of deaths certified by doctors, progress in integrating information systems, and a recommendation to digitise notifications in real time. It concerns the health side's certification and notification, and states nothing on how the civil registry office records a death, so no civil fact.
